ONE TO FOUR FAMILY RESIDENTIAL CONTRACT (RESALE)

1. PARTIES. The seller, Thomas Aurelio Harper and Eleanor Marguerite Harper (the "Seller"), agrees to sell and convey to the buyer, Nadia Harper Okonkwo (the "Buyer"), and Buyer agrees to buy from Seller the Property described below.

2. PROPERTY. Lot 14, Block 3, of the Sycamore Ridge Addition, an addition to the City of Austin, Travis County, Texas, according to the plat recorded in Document No. 2019-0114882, Official Public Records of Travis County, Texas, with the address 412 Sycamore Lane, Austin, Texas 78704, together with all improvements and fixtures.

3. SALES PRICE. Cash portion payable at closing: $180,000. Sum of all financing: $720,000. Sales Price: $900,000.

4. FINANCING. This contract is contingent on Buyer obtaining a conventional loan of $720,000 within twenty-one (21) days after the Effective Date. If Buyer cannot obtain Buyer Approval, Buyer may terminate this contract by notice to Seller within that period and the earnest money will be refunded to Buyer.

5. EARNEST MONEY AND TERMINATION OPTION. Buyer shall deposit $18,000 as earnest money with Bluebonnet Title Company, 2400 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701 (the "Escrow Agent"), within three days after the Effective Date. Buyer has paid Seller $300 as the Option Fee for the unrestricted right to terminate this contract by giving notice of termination within ten (10) days after the Effective Date. The Option Fee will be credited to the Sales Price at closing.

6. TITLE POLICY AND SURVEY. Seller shall furnish to Buyer at Seller's expense an owner's policy of title insurance in the amount of the Sales Price, issued by the Escrow Agent. Buyer may object in writing to any item in the Commitment or the survey within five days after receiving both. Seller shall deliver an existing survey and a Residential Real Property Affidavit (T-47) within ten days after the Effective Date.

7. PROPERTY CONDITION. Buyer accepts the Property in its present condition, subject to Seller's completion of any agreed repairs. Buyer may have the Property inspected by inspectors licensed by the Texas Real Estate Commission at Buyer's expense during the Option Period.

8. SELLER'S DISCLOSURE NOTICE. Seller has delivered the Seller's Disclosure Notice required by Texas Property Code § 5.008. Buyer has received it and had the opportunity to review it before signing.

9. HOMEOWNERS' ASSOCIATION. The Property is subject to mandatory membership in the Sycamore Ridge Homeowners Association. Seller shall deliver the subdivision information required by Texas Property Code § 207.003 within ten days after the Effective Date, at Seller's expense.

10. BROKERS. Listing broker: Harborview Realty, LLC. Buyer's broker: Larkspur Properties, Inc. Fees are paid under separate written agreements.

11. CLOSING. Closing will occur on or before June 15, 2026, or within seven days after objections to title are cured, whichever is later.

12. POSSESSION. Seller shall deliver possession of the Property to Buyer at closing and funding, in its present condition.

13. DEFAULT. If Buyer fails to comply, Seller may terminate and receive the earnest money as liquidated damages, or enforce specific performance. If Seller fails to comply, Buyer may terminate and receive the earnest money, or enforce specific performance.

14. MEDIATION. The parties agree to submit any dispute to mediation before resorting to arbitration or litigation.

15. ATTORNEY'S FEES. The prevailing party in any legal proceeding related to this contract is entitled to recover reasonable attorney's fees and costs.

16. NOTICES. All notices must be in writing and are effective when delivered to the addresses stated in Paragraph 20.

17. FEDERAL TAX REQUIREMENTS. If Seller is a "foreign person" as defined by the Internal Revenue Code, Buyer shall withhold from the sales proceeds and remit as the Code requires.

18. AGREEMENT OF PARTIES. This contract contains the entire agreement of the parties and cannot be changed except by written agreement.

19. EFFECTIVE DATE. The Effective Date is the date the Escrow Agent receipts this contract after all parties have signed.

20. ADDRESSES.
Seller: 412 Sycamore Lane, Austin, Texas 78704.
Buyer: 88 Beech Row, Austin, Texas 78702.

SELLER                                    BUYER

/s/ Thomas Aurelio Harper                 /s/ Nadia Harper Okonkwo
Thomas Aurelio Harper                     Nadia Harper Okonkwo

/s/ Eleanor Marguerite Harper
